purpose: Prevent recurrence of proven RAIOS/C5 maintenance defects

laws.incident: Manager repeatedly invoked C5/Ollama while system meaning was unchanged
laws.detect: Manager reasoning trigger must hash actionable gaps, not the full/telemetry snapshot
laws.remediation: Do not reason again until gap identity changes or bounded retry is required
laws.root_cause: Manager reasoning trigger included volatile/non-actionable state, causing repeated inference without a new decision gap
laws.mechanism: Heartbeat/age/telemetry changes altered the trigger hash and recursively caused C5 reasoning

laws.incident: qwen3:0.6b stayed hot and consumed large RAM while idle
laws.detect: Idle observation must produce zero C5/Ollama chat calls and Ollama model pool may unload
laws.remediation: Keep bounded keep_alive and remove periodic inference callers
laws.root_cause: Periodic inference refreshed Ollama keep_alive before expiry
laws.non_recurrence: 75-second idle proof ended with OLLAMA_MODELS=0 and FREE_MEM_GB=1.24
laws.mechanism: Repeated chat calls prevented qwen3:0.6b from unloading and consumed scarce RAM

laws.incident: Command Center health spawned git rev-parse per request and was slow
laws.detect: Health must return cached canonical head
laws.remediation: Load canonical head once at process start/deploy
laws.root_cause: Health endpoint and worker heartbeat spawned git rev-parse repeatedly on Windows
laws.non_recurrence: steady-state Command Center /health approximately 2.5-3.5 ms after caching canonical head
laws.mechanism: External process creation dominated a trivial health request

laws.incident: Acknowledged historical message was retried 26688 times
laws.detect: Worker must recognize historical actor ACK before retry/dead-letter
laws.remediation: Classify delivered and stop retries without forging a new ACK
laws.root_cause: New worker rescanned a historical message whose target was no longer routable and ignored its existing actor ACK
laws.non_recurrence: worker dead_letter=0; historical message classified DELIVERED with historical_ack=true
laws.mechanism: Retry classifier treated old acknowledged delivery as unresolved

laws.incident: Runtime could be copied from dirty working tree while advertising HEAD SHA
laws.detect: C5 deploy must reject dirty canonical source paths
laws.remediation: Commit approved source first, then deploy from clean canonical tree
laws.root_cause: Deployment copied bytes from working tree while labeling runtime with git HEAD SHA
laws.non_recurrence: Deploy-RAIOS-C5 fails closed with C5_CANONICAL_SOURCE_DIRTY before staging
laws.mechanism: HEAD identity was read from Git but copied source was not proven clean

laws.incident: Approved development waves overlapped on the same Git index
laws.detect: Active canonical change lease must exist and match approval/diff
laws.remediation: Serialize stage/approve/commit/push; other workers remain read/propose only
laws.root_cause: Multiple approved work waves shared one index/worktree concurrently
laws.mechanism: Approval gate serialized commits but did not serialize stage/approval windows

laws.incident: Internal council messaging failed because external A2A SDK module was missing
laws.detect: Council internal routes must use INTERNAL_BUS and not import a2a_all_hands in message path
laws.remediation: Load external A2A only for external A2A operations
laws.root_cause: Internal council message path imported external A2A SDK modules that were optional/missing
laws.non_recurrence: council internal route uses INTERNAL_BUS and tests pass without external a2a_all_hands import
laws.mechanism: A transport-independent internal operation inherited an unnecessary external dependency

laws.incident: Defined seats were treated as routable without actor/session consumer
laws.detect: Automatic routing requires presence + binding + consumer heartbeat
laws.remediation: Keep unbound seats offline; C1 explicit target remains C1_SELECTED_UNBOUND
laws.root_cause: Defined seat identity was previously conflated with current actor availability
laws.non_recurrence: ALL routes only to current present+bound+consumer seats; C12 excluded unless C1 explicitly selects it
laws.mechanism: Routing did not require live presence, session binding, and consumer heartbeat together

laws.incident: Delivery-to-mailbox risked being mistaken for actor read/acceptance
laws.detect: Transport worker must never synthesize actor ACK
laws.remediation: Only session consumer may emit actor ACK using bound actor/session identity
laws.root_cause: Mailbox delivery could be mistaken for actor read/acceptance
laws.non_recurrence: actor_ack_synthesized=false and only session consumer emits ACTOR_ACK=READ
laws.mechanism: Transport acknowledgement and human/actor consumption were not strongly separated

laws.incident: Dead-letter archive initially collided because message and worker-state shared filename
laws.detect: Archive artifacts from different roles must use unique destination names
laws.remediation: Verify hashes before removal and disclose any byte-level loss honestly
laws.root_cause: Different evidence roles used the same basename during archival
laws.non_recurrence: archive uses role-specific names and resolution record discloses byte-level loss/collision
laws.mechanism: Destination naming was filename-based rather than role-based

laws.incident: Model/provider identity risked being conflated with council seats
laws.detect: AI Gateway providers must not create council identities
laws.remediation: Models are capability providers; seats require actor/session binding
laws.root_cause: Capability provider identity risked being treated as council/actor identity
laws.non_recurrence: AI Gateway marks model_ne_council_seat=true and actor routing requires session-bound seats
laws.mechanism: Model routing and governance identity were not explicitly separated

laws.incident: C5 deploy attempted to copy new source over the live app directory and hit a locked neuro_lingua file
laws.root_cause: Staging and live runtime shared the same app directory
laws.mechanism: Copy-Item mutated live runtime bytes before stage validation, so running processes could hold files or observe mixed versions
laws.detect: Deployment must prepare and validate an independent app.stage before stopping/swapping the live app
laws.guard: StageAppRoot + stage health + live stop + atomic directory swap + rollback
laws.remediation: Never copy canonical packages into live app while C5 is running; validate separate staged bytes then cut over
laws.non_recurrence: Canonical deploy reports C5_LIVE_APP_MUTATION=false and C5_STAGE_VALIDATION=true
